edited_fraction: 142 to ~10,000 parameters on the 3.3M small model (selected edit 10,122); up to ~400,000 on the 0.4B model
cost_reported: 9-16 USD LLM cost per run; 1-2.5 h per run on the small model, up to 6 h on the large one (mostly waiting for the evaluation tool)
evidence_notes: WSP is one of three compared repair methods and the paper's central contribution alongside mechanistic localisation: Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code gets model code and weights and up to 50 evaluation-tool queries, editing body/classifier weights (PAGE 9). Task descriptions were fixed before launch and identified by checksums recorded before launch, with a discard rule declared in advance (PAGE 29); no registered analysis plan, hence internal. Removal rule (input-side fix) defines the target; LoRA and SAE edits are baselines; three runs per variant with up to 3x spread in remaining error (PAGE 10). Code, transcripts and weights released (GitHub, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.24377675, PAGE 15); cost PAGE 28.
